# Deploy to Cloud Run

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Deploy a container image to Cloud Run, optionally as a traffic-split canary

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/deploy-cloud-run@v1
  with:
    service: # Cloud Run service name.
    image: # Container image to deploy. Prefer an immutable digest ref.
```

## How it works

Deploy a container to Cloud Run, with optional traffic splitting for canaries.

Two deploy shapes, chosen by `traffic-percent`:
  • Left empty (default) — the new revision takes 100% of traffic immediately.
  • Set to a number — the revision deploys with `--no-traffic`, then that percentage is
    migrated to it. The remainder stays on whatever was serving before, which is what you
    want for a canary you intend to promote (or roll back) in a later step.

Authenticate with `gcp-auth` first.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `service` | **yes** | — | Cloud Run service name. |
| `image` | **yes** | — | Container image to deploy. Prefer an immutable digest ref. |
| `region` | no | `us-central1` | Cloud Run region. |
| `project-id` | no | `""` | GCP project. Empty uses the one gcp-auth resolved. |
| `env-vars` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `KEY=value` environment variables. |
| `secrets` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `KEY=secret-name:version` mappings from Secret Manager, e.g. `API_KEY=api-key:latest`. |
| `service-account` | no | `""` | Runtime service account email for the revision. |
| `min-instances` | no | `""` | Minimum instances. `0` scales to zero. |
| `max-instances` | no | `""` | Maximum instances. |
| `cpu` | no | `""` | CPU allocation, e.g. `1` or `2`. |
| `memory` | no | `""` | Memory allocation, e.g. `512Mi`. |
| `concurrency` | no | `""` | Max concurrent requests per instance. |
| `timeout` | no | `""` | Request timeout, e.g. `300s`. |
| `allow-unauthenticated` | no | `false` | true to grant public invoke access. Leave false for internal services. |
| `ingress` | no | `""` | all \| internal \| internal-and-cloud-load-balancing |
| `traffic-percent` | no | `""` | Percentage of traffic to send to the new revision. Empty means 100% immediately; a number deploys with no traffic and then migrates that share (canary). |
| `revision-suffix` | no | `""` | Suffix for the revision name. Empty lets Cloud Run generate one. |
| `flags` | no | `""` | Extra raw `gcloud run deploy` flags. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `url` | The service URL. |
| `revision` | Name of the revision that was created. |
